\u529f.title: merit; achievement

meaningDecisions.label: add
meaningDecisions.decision: Addition/increase/join/include and separate inflict/give sense do not mean merit or achievement. Shared 力 and five strokes make a useful shape contrast.

meaningDecisions.label: early childhood; immature
meaningDecisions.decision: Childhood/immaturity, also poetical young/innocent, do not mean merit or achievement. Shared 力 and five strokes supply a shape comparison, not etymology.

meaningDecisions.label: sword; blade
meaningDecisions.decision: A sword/blade, plus reading-restricted scalpel/engraving-tool/knife-money senses, is not merit or achievement. Distinguish the simple hooked outline from 力 in 功; do not identify their shapes or radicals.

directExclusions.label: achievements; results
directExclusions.reason: Direct achievement overlap, including the selected 功績 family. Neutral or unfavorable 成績 does not erase the shared achievement branch.

directExclusions.label: efficacy; effectiveness
directExclusions.reason: Daijisen's 功sense2 explicitly includes ききめ/功用; raw効 also has merit. Effectiveness is a defensible alternative for this secondary sense, not a reason to equate every compound.

directExclusions.label: fruit; fruition
directExclusions.reason: The fruition/achieved-outcome branch overlaps successful accomplishment; the literal fruit branch is unrelated.

directExclusions.label: become
directExclusions.reason: Conservative reverse-direction guard: 成るsense4 includes succeed/be accomplished and 成功 shares accomplishment. Not a claim that 功 means generic become.

directExclusions.label: reach, plural suffix
directExclusions.reason: Conservative reverse-direction guard for raw達's accomplished/attain sense and reaching a goal. Achievement can be defensible for that branch; no overlap is claimed with its people-plural suffix.

directExclusions.label: victory
directExclusions.reason: Victory is a successful achievement; guard the positive-success branch rather than making every success a contest win.

directExclusions.label: victory song; triumph
directExclusions.reason: The displayed triumph branch can express success/achievement; complete凱歌 includes victory itself, not only a song. No overlap with its separate calm/gentle sense is inferred.

directExclusions.label: flourish; glory
directExclusions.reason: Raw栄 honor/glory and prosperity overlap 功 honor/credit and successful accomplishment. The separateはえる shine/attractiveness family is not used to invent an allocation.

directExclusions.label: respect; honor
directExclusions.reason: Conservative displayed-English honor guard against 功's raw honor/credit branch. Honoring someone and having merit are not unrestricted Japanese substitutes.

directExclusions.label: work; function
directExclusions.reason: Daijisen defines 功 as superior work/働き and the effect of practice; 働く also has work/function/be effective. This broad English work/function label is unsafe as a guaranteed wrong choice, not proof that all labor is meritorious.

directExclusions.label: work, occupation
directExclusions.reason: The displayed work branch can answer 功's accomplished-work meaning; the distinct occupation and karmic senses are not identified with merit.

directExclusions.label: skill; technique
directExclusions.reason: Daijisen characterコウsense3 explicitly gives工夫/技術, as in気功. Skill/technique is therefore not guaranteed wrong for every ordinary character sense, despite the card foregrounding merit.

directExclusions.label: craft, construction
directExclusions.reason: Conservative craft/skill branch guard against the same explicitly documented工夫/技術 character sense. Not an etymological inference from shared 工 shape, nor a claim that every construction is a 功.
